title: The Mending of the State
summary: The calm before the storm. A young sultan, tributary to Castile and deep in debt, sets the state in order: the Catalan privileges, the war on Aragon and the peace of Balansiyya, the two ṭāʾifas of the east, Morocco's defeat of 1340, the Jamāʿa of 1344 and the crown it strengthened, and the debt paid down. It ends the day Morocco declares war again.

title: The Balance
summary: Granada on the scales between the three crowns of Iberia and the Marīnids, from the season sovereignty first slipped below 50. It closes when Castile is pushed back for good, or when the scale tips the other way. Written as it happens.

title: The Pestilence
summary: The Black Death, from the first rumours out of the east and the hospitals the amir raised against it in Gharnāṭa, Mālaqa and al-Mariyya. Runs beside the Book of the Balance. Written as it happens.
